implementation.temperate_lobe_topology: 12 rings by 24 segments; rainforest and Zambezi remain on their retained 8 by 16 path
implementation.conifer_change: irregular tier/radius/azimuth offsets plus a third overlapping inner lobe on every branch
implementation.broadleaf_change: continuous branch radius, height, crown scale, and eight-lobe crown-fill variation
implementation.material_change: deterministic HISM per-instance energy range 0.88-1.13 over opaque vertex color
implementation.placement_change: exact-ratio 20-instance blocks use coprime permutation 7, deterministic block rotation, continuous height, yaw, and footprint variation
implementation.collision: disabled presentation-only vegetation; river physics and solver surfaces unchanged

accepted_findings: The fixed Futaleufu and Chilko views no longer repeat the former fixed species/height sequence downriver.
Higher-resolution solid lobes and denser conifer overlap reduce the harshest plate facets and bare mid-crown gaps without reintroducing alpha-card walls.
Per-instance radiometry and continuous footprint variation break the previous single-value canopy wall while retaining deterministic generation.
Both regenerated runnable maps preserve 6200 total vegetation instances, the 4650/1550 canopy-understory split, live water, player raft, game mode, and focused runtime-map contracts.
rejected_isolated_brackets: A smaller-crownlet/three-spray prototype exposed trunks and increased repeated low-poly spires.
A flattened conifer cap produced mushroom silhouettes on bare poles.
Removing the cap while retaining the full trunk exposed tapered brown spikes at gameplay distance.
Nanite Preserve Area on disconnected solid lobes expanded the canopy into wall-like slabs and was rejected immediately.
remaining_photoreal_blockers: The project-owned tree family still has only one broadleaf and one conifer morphology; crowns remain visibly procedural and tiered.
Exact Patagonian and Chilcotin species identity, ecology, seasonal state, wind response, guide review, and measured desktop/VR performance remain external acceptance gates.
The retained fixed views still show broad simplified bank surfaces, sparse near-bank micro-vegetation, and water that is too flat and uniform for photoreal approval.
A production canopy needs multiple dense distance-stable rights-reviewed adult tree variants or a substantially more detailed first-party botanical pipeline.
